name: Digging for Answers
summary: The Twilight's Hammer is digging through the Riverglades for an unknown source of power. You are sent to Sunnyglade to question one of their miners.

sections.title: Miners in Sunnyglade
sections.body: The Twilight's Hammer has workers digging in Sunnyglade, and you are sent to question one of the miners. Their search points to a source of power, but its nature remains unknown. The zealots keep their secrets close, so the miners may know what they seek.

faq.q: What is the Twilight's Hammer digging for?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer appears to be searching for a source of power in the Riverglades, but what it is remains unknown.

faq.q: Why am I questioning a miner?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer zealots keep their secrets, so you are sent to question one of their miners in Sunnyglade.
The miners are digging in Sunnyglade, within the Riverglades.
